answer: Attackers must acquire and lock real tokens per fake identity, so costs scale linearly with the sock-puppet tide they attempt. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted beacon registration: each agent locks quartz tokens as collateral before joining an epoch, and a rotating beacon assigns voting weight proportional to locked stake. Slashing burns the quartz on proven duplicate-identity fraud, raising the marginal price of each additional puppet until the tide recedes. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
